importantLimitations: Roster entries reflect the scoring period contained in the export, not confirmed draft results.
Championship roster appearances mean a player appeared on the exported roster of the team with final standing 1.
Estimated playoff appearances use playoff seeds 1 through 6 because the export does not contain explicit playoff qualification flags.
Owner names are grouped only by trimmed, case-insensitive matching. No unrelated names were manually merged.
methodology.prestigeFormula: 30 per championship + 14 per runner-up + 5 per top-four finish + 0.35 per win + 1.5 per season + win percentage x 20; normalized so the highest raw score equals 100.
methodology.hallOfFameFormula: 35 per championship + 15 per runner-up + 0.25 per win + 2 per season + 4 per top-four finish; normalized so the highest raw score equals 100.
